resources.name: FrontRow
resources.desc: Open source React Native concert ticketing app built specifically as a QA automation training surface. Ships Appium WebdriverIO and TypeScript scaffolds with full WDIO configs for iOS and Android, smoke and login specs, and a central testID registry that maps to accessibility identifiers on both platforms. Includes a QA Debug Menu with force error modes, time travel, and deterministic IAP outcomes for practising failure mode testing.
